content.short: Fractal is an open marketplace for gaming NFTs.
content.description: Fractal is a marketplace for gaming NFTs that supports discovery, purchase, and resale of NFT games. Launched in December 2021 by Justin Kan, Robin Chan, and David Wurtz, Fractal enables players to buy directly from game publishers and resell titles within the ecosystem. Developers can list NFT drops for durable in-game assets and sell them straight to players. They can also make gaming NFTs available to buyers before a game officially launches, enabling early access and demand building.
